name: Sowa's Quantification Example (2011, p.356)
description: Sowa's quantification example (2011 tutorial, p.356): ∀x (Human(x) → Mortal(x)) drawn as Peirce draws it — the scroll ~[ (Human *x) ~[ (Mortal x) ] ], one line of identity running from the antecedent into the consequent. The universal needs no quantifier symbol: it is the nesting that binds.
